body:
Use task check with its Go, Task, Python/PyYAML and Docsync prerequisites, plus lore setup/render when hydrating a clone. Root go test ./... alone excludes nested contrib modules and the documentation/negative-build gates. A baseline task check with no database DSNs is useful, but its passing result does not execute the gated server suites.

Evidence: ds:block?id=workspace-f7vpgvxp; ds:block?id=gate-9g2wphfm; ds:block?id=postgres-gate-ctc94x6a; ds:block?id=mysql-gate-xzbtwu8b. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: A root-only test command misses nested modules
